name: HYBRIDIZATION OVEN
desc: Premium Hybridization Oven designed for molecular biology laboratories specializing in nucleic acid hybridization and blot analysis. We at Innolab Instruments manufacture this unit with a 560-liter capacity, precise microprocessor PID digital controller, and an integrated bottle rotator.
features: Microprocessor PID digital controller with 0.1°C display resolution
Supplied with a carrier to hold 6 bottles (30mm dia x 200mm depth)
Rotates continuously at a controlled speed of 10 to 30 rpm
Natural Air circulation with double-walled Stainless Steel 304 inner chamber
Transparent glass viewing window in the door to inspect the chamber
